title: Unbounded append with strncat (c)
description: The code appends with strncat, whose size argument counts only the bytes copied, not the terminator or the existing length. A loop that appends into the same buffer therefore writes one byte past the end each time. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer checks the destination capacity.
remediation: Size the destination first and append with the remaining capacity, for example a container append with a checked capacity.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call without tracking destination capacity across statements.
